lessons: In specs/requisition_review.md Output format, spell out the exact reply schema: {"verdict": "approve"|"snag"|"rma", "summary": "<non-blank>", "findings": [...]}, and say findings is empty exactly for approve. Reply with ONLY the JSON object.

Name every Finding key literally: `code`, `message`, `paved_road` (all non-blank, required), optional `path` (string or null) and `line` (integer >= 1 or null), and no other keys. Copy the wording from an existing spec's Output format such as specs/review.md.

Keep the rest of the diff as it is: code, fence, render helper, and race rename all passed review and all four verification commands. Change only the spec text, then rerun lint_spec and the full pytest suite.
Optional hardening: add a test in tests/test_requisition.py that checks the spec's Output format text names `paved_road`, so a key drift fails a test and not only review.
